notes.title: 1.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays! It's a few days early, but the 24th happens to be not just Christmas Eve, but also the quarterversary of Pawnbarian's release. I'm still not quite used to the fact that there are enough of you who chose to grab the game that I can keep being a fully independent game developer, release these patches, and start working on another project. Thank you!

Patch 1.1.4 brings full gamepad support to the game, and should make it fully Steam Deck-ready.

new: full gamepad support, automatically hotswappable with with keyboard & mouse controls at any time
new: a screen showing the gamepad controls, accessible from the settings menu
new: tutorial explains gamepad controls (if applicable)
change: slightly updated the tutorial in general
change: menus have more consistent styling
change: reworked the entire underlying input system - this should be mostly invisible, but you have to set keyboard shortcuts again if you've been using any non-default ones
change: updated Polish translation

Cheers,
Jan

notes.title: 1.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The Pawnbarian is now Mr. Worldwide! 1.1.3 brings an official Polish translation (cześć i czołem!), as well as support for trivially modding in community translations, and an easy way to translate via Crowdin.

I'd love you to help! Read on in the new Steam Community subforum and sticky:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1142080/discussions/4/3156454576342449483/

It's not a huge undertaking - there are roughly 300 strings and 2.4k (English) words to translate for the game, and a bit extra for the Steam store page if you're feeling up to it.

build a802ee9:
fix: "Abandon Run" now does, in fact, abandon the run

notes.title: 1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
A tweak to solve a long-standing issue confusing some newcomers to the game, and a more pleasant game reset flow for everyone.

change: overhauled the dungeon select screen with a more intuitive layout
change: exiting to menu after a loss, victory, or abandoning the run now goes to character select
change: exiting to menu after the tutorial now goes to dungeon select with Goblin Caves selected
change: description now makes it clear that the Knight piece "jumps" instead of "moving"
fix: upgrade icons now properly restore their full scale when going down from 5 upgrades

notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
new: you can now hover over cards in the deck or discard to see a detailed description
change/fix: lots of improvements to some sprites appearing blurry or aliased at certain resolutions
change/fix: the game will now keep trying to connect to Steam for a while after launching, and retroactively award achievements upon successful connection

If you're still not receiving the achievements, please launch the game, wait a minute, and submit a bug report following these instructions (steps 3-5).

build 1d47304 (macOS only):
fix: adjusted Steam configuration for Apple Silicon devices

build 127e050:
fix: Chain 0 achievements now properly awarded retroactively in all circumstances

notes.title: 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Pawnbarian's first gameplay update is here!

It ended up being a pretty substantial balance overhaul, even with a bit of new content, so I didn't dive into the Chain progression after all - it might still be necessary, but no point in fiddling with too many variables at once. Overall, the changes should open up more options to deal with whatever the game throws at you.

Hope you enjoy!
Jan

new: Purify, a Blight-cleansing upgrade available only for the Knight Templar (for now??? :>)
new: vfx for Spark Imp's Golem Soul activation
change: shop has 5 upgrades (was 4)
change: Kraken Tentacle no longer has Brawler
change: all Blight Wake enemies move twice (new for Kraken, Tentacles, Blighted Capybear)
change: King Golem randomly spawns either a Guard Golem or a Knight Golem (was just Guards)
change: Pawnbarian checks the 3 Pawn promotion trigger after the row trigger (was before)
change: Knight Templar starts with Purify instead of Shield on one of the Knights
change: Shogun's Pawns start with 2 Cantrip and 1 Cardinal Splash (was 3 Cantrip)
change: every third Gauntlet Floor is a boss fight (wasn't spawning bosses at all)
change: Gauntlet Floors in the Golem Fortress spawn with 3 Spark Imps (wasn't spawning Imps at all)
change: improved clarity of many descriptions
change: made some flavor text more flavorful

build acc6265:
fix: King Golem description no longer partially missing

notes.title: 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- added extra failsafes and backup steps to protect from potential save file corruption
- fixed game launching in a broken state when encountering save file corruption
- fixed Goblin Caves boss not being influenced by Chain X

build 8dbecc2:
- fixed issue with strings not loading properly for systems with locale other than en-US

build 810d645:
- changed the saving mechanism to pre-1.0.6 if encountering a file access violation

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- changed "Click Again" prompts to timeout-based (so they're now usable with a touchscreen)
- changed Settings placeholder strings shown when the game starts in a broken state to something more useful
- fixed Shogun being able to make illegal moves after using Dragon Drop while having a card selected
- fixed Exit Portal sfx sometimes not playing

notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- changed shogi piece icons to kanji + pattern instead of just kanji
(this is currently the only way; the old display might come back as an option in a future update)
- changed Spark Surge description to clarify that it only attacks the targeted squares like a normal attack
- fixed Spark sfx when a Cantrip card is selected continuing to play after abandoning the run

notes.title: 1.0.2 + 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.0.2
- added "Restart Dungeon" button on the game over screen
- changed LMB to be the only button accepted for click inputs
- changed RMB to deselect current card (even when not hovering over it)
- fixed bizarre vertically-oriented resolutions being available on some monitors

1.0.3
- fixed newly introduced bug where using "Restart Dungeon" after dying on the boss floor or in the Gauntlet kept playing boss music for the entirety of the new run

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- fixed increased Life cost not being stored in saves
- fixed wacky board state being possible against Golem Fortress boss and miniboss

notes.title: New Demo, Tiny Teams 2021, Release News
notes.notes:
There's a new demo available to play! Some things got a major overhaul, and everything was touched up in one way or another. Additionally, for the first time ever, there's a native Mac version. This is a near-final state of the game, so there's never been a better time to tell a friend to check it out. Wink wink. 

Just like last year, Pawnbarian was selected for Yogscast Games' Tiny Teams festival, which launches right now! Over the next week, exclusively for the duration of the event, the second character - the Knight Templar - is unlocked in the demo.

https://yogsca.st/TinyTeams

Look around for other cool games made by small devs, and check out Pawnbarian on The Yogscast's stream on August 8 (that's tommorow) during the 19-22 UTC timeslot. (below times are in BST)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35770431/44ef3aefe5efde91eacfb1e14c4011d981e813ff.png

Finally, the game is very close to release! I don't have an exact date for you yet, but it's next month - September 2021.

Hope you enjoy, and I look forward to hearing your feedback.
Jan
